$description: Theme registry for the Contera presentation layer. Non-authoritative — see context/manifest.md §7. Per the migration instructions: if multiple themes are not defined in the source material, none are invented here.

themes.name: Contera Threshold Design System
themes.qualifier: Document-level status is 'Working design specification' in design-system.md — the system as a whole is still being iterated on. This is distinct from the per-claim DEFINED/WORKING_HYPOTHESIS status of individual sections; see context/data/design-tokens.json for those.
themes.description: The single currently supported presentation system. Governs color, type, the governance-tier visual language, and icons. See context/data/design-tokens.json for its token values.

note: No second theme (e.g., a distinct dark-mode theme, a white-label variant, or a high-contrast mode) is defined anywhere in the source material. The Approval governance tier's surface inversion to gray-950 (design-system.md §3) is a component-level state within the single Threshold theme — a governance-tier signal, not a separate theme or a user-selectable light/dark mode. Do not construct a second theme entry from that inversion. If additional themes become necessary, they must be defined in source/design-system.md (or its successor) first, per context/manifest.md's provenance rule, before being represented here.
